scope: Real Firebase Auth SDK, local demo Auth emulator only; no successful Firestore integration claimed

checks.check: A real nameless Auth account starts with editable name, readonly email and account fallback
Whitespace-only and 101-character names are rejected before any accounts:update request
Saving trims surrounding whitespace and immediately refreshes profile, sidebar, both avatars and dashboard without reload
Saved displayName survives a browser reload
Saved displayName survives logout and a fresh UI login
Editing an existing displayName refreshes all identity surfaces
The 100-character boundary is accepted and can be changed back
Pending state survives profile navigation and rapid repeated submissions make exactly one accounts:update request
Aborted Auth update shows an error without success and leaves the saved identity unchanged after reload
A delayed save from the previous account cannot overwrite the next account identity or report success there
Both accounts retain their own saved names after account switching
Editable profile has no horizontal overflow at 1440, 390 and 320 pixels
Auth uses loopback; off-origin Firestore connectivity probes are blocked and no uncaught JavaScript errors occur
Only this run's temporary Auth emulator accounts are deleted
